All 6 tests pass.

**Fix:** The only failing test was `test_collapse_runs` — `slugify("Hello   World")` returned `'hello--world'` instead of `'hello-world'`. The old line `...strip("-").replace("--", "-")...` collapsed runs only once, so a 3-dash run (`"hello---world"`) became just 2 dashes. I replaced it with a proper collapse `re.sub(r"-{2,}", "-", ...)` and added the stdlib `import re` (no new dependencies). The test file is untouched.
